detail.longDescription: Remote servers can track your real identity by analyzing your computer’s unique clock drift. The PH4NTXM Clock Fuzz Engine stops this silently. Every time you boot, the engine injects a strict time offset based on your active profile. ±20 seconds for Linux, ±60 for Windows, ±90 for Lonewolf. It alters clock ticks and injects sub-second random adjustments while keeping the time clean enough so internet certificates don't break. Any network scanner trying to measure your uptime or clock signature gets nothing but synthetic noise. Zero time leaks, by design. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
